questions.stem: How many bits are needed to give 20 different items their own distinct binary code?
questions.explain: 4 bits give only 16 codes. 5 bits give 32 codes, which covers 20.

questions.stem: What is the binary number 1010 1100 in hexadecimal?
questions.explain: Convert each group of four bits: 1010 is A and 1100 is C, so the value is AC.

questions.stem:
What does this program print?

```python
w = 0b1101
print((w >> 1) & 0b11)
```
questions.explain: w = 1101 in binary. Shifting right by one gives 110. Masking with 11 keeps the low two bits, 10, which is 2.
